column1: 验证器 PIN 只管这一个功能，和锁屏密码分开。账号加密存在 TF 卡上，解锁要 PIN 和这台设备一起，换卡或换设备都解不开。忘了 PIN 没有找回办法，只能清空验证器，再从手机 Google Authenticator 重新导入。4 位数字只有 1 万种，防得住别人随手试，防不住专门破解的人。自动上锁点一下切换。
column2: The PIN only covers this feature and is separate from the lock PIN. Accounts are encrypted on the TF card, and unlocking needs the PIN together with this device, so another card or device cannot open them. A forgotten PIN cannot be recovered: clear the authenticator and import again from Google Authenticator on your phone. Four digits are only 10,000 combinations: this stops casual tries but not a determined attacker. Tap Auto-lock to switch.

column1: 在这台设备上离线显示两步验证码，和手机 Google Authenticator 算出的一样，不需要服务器。\n先设一个验证器 PIN（4 位数字），再用设备热点从手机导入账号。手机上的 Google Authenticator 请一直保留作备份。
column2: Shows two-step codes offline on this device, the same as Google Authenticator on your phone, no server needed.\nSet an authenticator PIN (4 digits) first, then import accounts from your phone over the device hotspot. Keep Google Authenticator on your phone as a backup.

column2: This deletes the encrypted file on the TF card and the matching random value in the device. All accounts are gone. Set a PIN again afterwards and import from your phone again.
